negative_findings.description: LinkedIn post-level search is not reachable from a logged-out client. Public web search surfaces LinkedIn PROFILE pages (and their headline/summary text) but almost never individual 'nastupuji do' / 'excited to join' POST permalinks for CZ banking.
negative_findings.result_summary: Four idiom-based queries in cs and en returned profile URLs and unrelated pages, no retrievable post permalinks.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core premise — that individuals announce moves before their employer does — is true, but the announcement text itself is not machine-collectable at scale without LinkedIn credentials or a licensed data provider. Collection design must lean on profile-headline diffing plus press-side mirrors.

negative_findings.description: No Czech banking or payments professional/institutional accounts were identified on Bluesky beyond a generic #Czech hashtag feed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query for CZ banking/fintech on bsky.app returned bank websites and one hashtag page, no sector accounts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bluesky is the only openly crawlable microblog of the three; if the CZ banking community is not there, the open-data path for this cell is effectively closed and budget should go to LinkedIn-mirroring press instead.

negative_findings.description: Official X accounts were confirmed for Air Bank and Raiffeisenbank ČR, but no X account was confirmed for Komerční banka or ČSOB in this pass (Komerční banka appeared only via Facebook, Raiffeisenbank ČR also via Instagram).
negative_findings.result_summary: cs-language query for official CZ bank X profiles returned two X handles plus Facebook/Instagram alternates.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Absence here is unverified, not established — it should be retested before concluding the two largest banks have abandoned X, since X's own search is login-walled and search engines index it poorly.

negative_findings.description: No established Czech-language equivalent was found for 'alumni note' / 'leaver post' as a discrete content genre; Czech leavers write free-form 'po X letech odcházím' style posts with no canonical phrase, and no Czech bank alumni network page was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches produced no CZ bank alumni association or leaver-note convention.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Departures are the higher-signal half of org change (they precede a vacancy and often a strategy shift) and this run currently has no reliable local-language query handle for them.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-sector actors (acquirers, PSPs, processors, card schemes, POS/ATM vendors operating in CZ — e.g. Global Payments CZ, Worldline, Monet+, ComGate, GoPay) have far thinner LinkedIn coverage in this slice than the retail banks; only scheme-side (Visa) and generic CEE profiles were captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass enumerating CZ acquirer/PSP legal entities from the ČNB register and the Czech Fintech Association member list, then map each to its LinkedIn company page and its named country/product leads.

coverage_gaps.description: No sanctioned, ToS-compliant mechanism has been identified for observing LinkedIn profile-headline changes over time, which is the single highest-value derivable signal in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate licensed alternatives (LinkedIn Sales Navigator alerts, Talent Insights, or a commercial workforce-data vendor such as Revelio/Live Data Technologies) and price them against the analyst-hours of manual monitoring; do not build a scraper.

coverage_gaps.description: Captured profiles skew to C-level and board tier. The cell's stated rationale is that mid-level and lateral moves are the bulk of org change, and those individuals are precisely the ones public search does not surface.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the mid-tier follow list by snowballing from the captured executive profiles' comment threads and from named individuals appearing in bankovnictvionline.cz/personalie and mediar.cz, rather than by query.

coverage_gaps.description: Czech-language querying was productive for appointment idioms ('jmenování ředitelem', 'nastupuji do', 'jsem hrdý') but was not extended to Slovak, despite heavy CZ/SK talent circulation in banking and payments and shared employers (Privatbanka, Vacuumlabs surfaced incidentally).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Slovak variants ('nastupujem do', 'menovanie riaditeľom', 'som hrdý') to the query set and treat SK-domiciled sources as in-scope pointers for CZ moves.

coverage_gaps.description: Because the direct channel (LinkedIn/X posts) is auth-walled, this slice is disproportionately dependent on indirect press mirrors, which lag the self-report by days to weeks and filter out non-senior moves.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Accept the press mirrors as the automated backbone and reserve direct LinkedIn observation for a curated watchlist of 30-60 named individuals reviewed manually on a fixed cadence.

brief: The self-reported professional social signal for CZ banking and payments is real and rich but structurally hard to collect: LinkedIn is where Czech bankers announce moves first, in both Czech ('nastupuji do', 'jsem hrdý', 'jmenování ředitelem') and English ('excited to join'), yet only profile pages — not post permalinks — are reachable from a logged-out client, so the announcement text itself resists automated capture. X retains official bank accounts (Air Bank, Raiffeisenbank ČR confirmed) but is login-walled and low-signal for personnel news, and Bluesky shows no meaningful Czech banking community at all. The practical architecture is therefore two-layer: a curated manual watchlist of named executive and specialist LinkedIn profiles for early sight, backed by an automated crawl of Czech personnel-change rubrics — bankovnictvionline.cz/personalie above all, plus MediaGuru, e15, Peníze.cz, ManagementNews and NejBusiness — which mirror the same self-reports within days and are openly accessible. The largest remaining gaps are payments-sector actors (acquirers, PSPs, processors) and the mid-level lateral tier that the cell exists to catch.
